messages.subject: I have a problem that is 'rJava' and 'KoNLP' package deploy.
parts:
help~~

my local machine is running but not deploy.


Below is My source code

library(shiny)
library(tm)
library(stringr)
library(rJava)
library(KoNLP)

# Define UI for data upload app ----
ui <- fluidPage(
  
  # App title ----
  titlePanel("Topkeyword Producing"),
  
  # Sidebar layout with input and output definitions ----
  sidebarLayout(
    
    # Sidebar panel for inputs ----
    sidebarPanel(
      
      # Input: Select a file ----
      fileInput("file1", "Choose csv or txt File",
                multiple = TRUE,
                accept = c("text/csv",
                           "text/comma-separated-values,text/plain",
                           ".csv")),
      
      # Horizontal line ----
      tags$hr()
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      
      tableOutput("contents")
      
    )
    
  )
)

# Define server logic to read selected file ----
server <- function(input, output) {
  
  output$contents <- renderTable({
    
    req(input$file1)
    f <- file(input$file1$datapath, blocking = F, open='r')
    txtlines <- readLines(f, skipNul = T, encoding="UTF-8")
    close(f)
    
    txtlines <- str_replace_all(txtlines, "[^[:alnum:]]", " ")
    txtlines <- toupper(txtlines)
    
    nounslist <- alply(txtlines, 1, extractNoun, .inform=T)
    nouns <- unlist(nounslist)
    realnouns <- nouns[nchar(nouns) >= 2]
    wordcount <- sort(table(realnouns), decreasing=T)
    wordcountfr <- as.data.frame(wordcount)
    
    return(wordcountfr)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

***********************************************************************************************************
